description.value:
A shimmering, immobile barrier forms in a 10-foot radius around you and lasts for the duration. A tech power of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier cannot affect anything within it, even from a higher-level slot; such a power can still target things inside the barrier, but produces no effect on them, and areas of effect from such powers are excluded from the barrier's interior.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 7th level or higher, the barrier blocks powers of one level higher for each slot level above 6th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
